invariants.statement: Permissions are a closed vocabulary: the kernel pattern plus the 34 SUITE_PERMISSIONS; a grant naming any other permission is refused by the schema.

strata.how: capability-def ids (namespaced per product) and tenant-permission (capability or object-action, exactly one) form a closed set validated by the schema.

invariants.statement: Suite permissions are checked on plinth://<ws>/suite/<module>; a grant on the prefix plinth://<ws>/suite/ covers every module.

strata.how: a capability guards only the operations of its product (capability-def), so no resource prefix is needed.

invariants.statement: A grant with principal role:<slug> applies to every subject in that Role node's members; the principal pattern refuses any other form for role grants.

strata.how: a tenant-role is held by a person through role-assignment or team membership.

invariants.statement: A role member with scope region inherits every grant of the role with region = '<region>' ANDed into the row predicate (region = '<region>' when the grant had none); a scoped manager never sees another region's rows.

strata.how: role assignments carry no scope, and policies have no row predicate on the target record's region.

invariants.statement: A grant with owner_only true matches a node only when that node's spec.owner equals the effective principal; members write only their own Preference, Page and Widget nodes.
source: lean/Strata/Proofs.lean:10 owner, editors and writers on their own records

strata.how: a policy with a condition comparing the record owner to the principal; read-side filtering of owned records must be checked in the query path.
strata.note: Read-side filter for owner-only nodes not verified in Strata.

invariants.statement: An owner_only grant never matches a node with no spec.owner (context.owner absent), so a missing owner denies rather than allows.

strata.how: policy condition over an absent field evaluates false.

invariants.statement: Only grants with status active and not expired count: pending_approval, rejected, revoked and expired grants grant nothing.

strata.how: Strata grants and role assignments have no status or expiry.

invariants.statement: With no live grant for the effective subject, the decision is deny (reason no_grant); an explicit deny grant overrides allow.

strata.how: an action is permitted only when a role's permission grants it; absence denies.

invariants.statement: A Grant may carry effect deny, and a deny grant wins over an allow on the same resource.

strata.how: Strata's grant union has no effect, so deny-overrides-allow is not expressible.

invariants.statement: Role membership and Grant nodes are read from one snapshot; any commit touching a Grant or Role bumps grant_index_version so cached policy decisions are invalidated.

strata.note: Plinth authorizer implementation detail; the port needs cache invalidation on any role or grant change, which Strata's policy engine must provide (not checked).

invariants.statement: An approver must be a human principal; an agent can never decide a held change or action.

strata.how: approval requires a signed-in person, not automation (approvals.rs rule 1).

invariants.statement: An approver is never the requester of the held change (sod:requester).

strata.how: workflow approvals refuse the person who started the run (approvals.rs:115-117); held node changes are not covered.

invariants.statement: An approver is never the subject the requesting agent acts for (sod:on_behalf_of), so Maya cannot approve an agent action filed for Maya.

strata.how: the acting claim (act) is recorded on tokens; the refusal to approve on behalf of a delegator is not built for held changes.

invariants.statement: A decision needs approval:decide on the held resource (or suite/approvals for Suite rules) and the rule's approver permission (APPROVER_PERMISSION); missing either refuses.

strata.how: approvals need a role named by the policy plus workflow-approve (approvals.rs rules 2 and 3); the per-rule approver permission for node changes is not built.

invariants.statement: A held change or action expires: change_approvals.expires_at and action_approvals (created_at plus 7 days); an expired hold cannot be decided.

strata.how: approval deadlines are checked (approvals.rs:118) for workflow approvals.

invariants.statement: Two approvers deciding the same held change at once result in exactly one decision; the second is refused.

strata.how: concurrent approval decisions are the WG-5488 gap.
evidence: Workgraph WG-5488 (no matches in strata-plinth docs)

invariants.statement: A disabled principal is refused on every request (principal_disabled) and cannot be resolved by subject.

strata.how: principal-state exists (active, suspended, erased); a tenant local suspension that refuses every request is WG-5490.

invariants.statement: An agent acting for a delegator with no current delegation is refused (delegation_revoked); the agent never acts without a live delegator.

strata.how: agent delegation token has revoked_at and expires_at; the token is refused when revoked.

invariants.statement: The agent's effective rights are its ceiling intersected with its delegator's grants; a permission outside the ceiling is refused (ceiling_denies) and a token scope narrows further (token_scope_denies).

strata.how: delegation token scopes are limited to the person's own permissions (TOK-004); a separate per-agent ceiling list is not built.

invariants.statement: The agent ceiling never includes approval:decide, admin:members, admin:roles, admin:settings, points:adjust, points:ledger, promotions:approve, content:review, content:publish, store:refund or people:view-private.

strata.how: a fixed agent ceiling list (F-agent-ceiling); the code currently violates the contract by listing admin:settings in AGENT_SUITE_CEILING, and site.* actions run as agent direct (see M18).
strata.note: Discrepancy found: admin:settings is in AGENT_SUITE_CEILING; CONTRACT §3.6 says agent no. Resolve in the spec before the port.

invariants.statement: The agent never holds approval:decide, so it cannot approve its own held action or a change made for it.

strata.how: approval requires a person other than the author (approve-proposal) and a person, not automation (approvals.rs rule 1).

invariants.statement: A person cannot disable themselves (SELF_ACTION on admin.member_status) and cannot change their own role membership (SELF_ACTION on admin.role_members); any role change by an admin is approved by a different admin.

strata.how: Strata's assign-role refuses above-own grants and the last owner but not self-assignment (transition.rs; no self refusal found).

invariants.statement: A person may confer only a role whose permissions they already hold; the owner role is conferred only by an owner. This Plinth rule is carried by the held R-ROLE approval, not by a conferrable check.

strata.how: require_conferrable refuses an assignment whose role grants more than the assigner holds, and an owner role may be conferred only by an owner.

invariants.statement: No rule found that keeps at least one admin in the workspace; a disable or role removal can remove the last admin.

strata.how: Strata refuses a change that leaves no effective owner (require_an_owner_remains); the SCIM path is WG-5486.

invariants.statement: Every change to a Role node by a human or an agent is held for approval (R-ROLE, approver admin:roles and approval:decide on Role/), except the system surface.

strata.how: role assignment checks run immediately; a held approval of role changes is not built.

invariants.statement: Every Grant change by a non-system principal, including deletion, is held for approval with approver grant:write (R-GRANT).

strata.how: create-grant and revoke-grant exist; the second-person hold is not built.

invariants.statement: Undoing a Grant change is classified auto (R-GRANT-UNDO) before the human branch, so no approval is required to reverse a grant revocation or grant. Possible authorization gap in Plinth; the port must hold undo of authorization changes.

strata.how: Strata has no undo of grants (not checked); the rule for the port is that reversal of an authorization change is a held change.
strata.note: Verify whether undo of a Grant also checks grant:write; the rule text alone would allow it.

invariants.statement: An agent undoing a change made by someone else is held (R-UNDO-FOREIGN); its own change may be undone automatically (R-UNDO-OWN).

strata.how: a held undo for agents; the port needs the same rule for every surface.

invariants.statement: An agent may not change a Source or the action registry (R-SOURCE refused).

strata.how: agents write only through their ceiling; product metadata changes are a development path, not a tenant operation.

invariants.statement: An agent may create an Automation only with enabled false (R-AUTOMATION-CREATE refuses enabled true).

strata.how: a policy condition on principal-kind agent and the new record's enabled flag, refused otherwise.

invariants.statement: Every registry action carries an agent policy: direct (reads), preview (dry run, then commit with the token), approval (dry run, then the commit is filed) or deny (FORBIDDEN, ceiling_denies).

strata.how: preview-tokens and action-preview cover preview; the per-action agent policy and the approval-filing step are not built.

invariants.statement: The existing kernel grants (ops-lead-all, the finance-board grants, Jonas's EMEA row grant on the ops board) remain alongside the Suite role grants.

strata.how: Suite seed grants cannot be expressed as role grants alone; a named grant with a row predicate is the Plinth-specific form (F-row-scoped-grants).

invariants.statement: ROLE_GRANTS also grants node:read per kind beyond the §3.6 matrix: member reads Product, Category, Badge, Group, Program, Page, Widget; content-editor reads Segment and Panel; manager reads Segment, Promotion and Content; finance reads Promotion, Segment and Automation; admin reads all kinds it writes.

strata.how: object-action read on the object type per role.
strata.note: The §3.6 matrix omits these node reads; the port must include them.

invariants.statement: A promotion moving draft to scheduled or active, or an edit of eligibility, effects, budget or schedule while live, is held for promotions:approve; the marketing manager cannot approve their own (AC-PROMO-ACTIVATE).

strata.how: no held-change approval for node edits in Strata.

invariants.statement: Promotion pause, end, and resume are auto for any principal (R-PROMO-CONTROL); the scheduler's own moves are auto under the system surface (R-PROMO-SCHEDULE).

strata.how: a tenant operation step on the promotion record, and a scheduled trigger.

invariants.statement: Editing a draft promotion (status excluded) is auto for any principal (R-PROMO-EDIT); creating a promotion as an agent is auto with status draft (R-PROMO-CREATE).

strata.how: update-record on a draft-status record, with the status field excluded from the step's writable fields.

invariants.statement: Changing price or status of a Product by an agent is held for store:inventory (R-PRODUCT-PRICE); create as draft and non-price edits are auto.

strata.how: price edits are a managed field written only by an action; the hold for store:inventory needs held-change approvals.

invariants.statement: An agent may create a Badge only as draft (R-BADGE-CREATE, auto); any edit of an existing badge by an agent is held for badges:award (R-BADGE-EDIT).

strata.how: draft status by a create-record step; the edit hold needs held-change approvals.

invariants.statement: An agent enabling an automation, or editing an enabled one, is held for automation:manage (R-AUTOMATION-ENABLE); editing a disabled automation is auto (R-AUTOMATION-EDIT).

strata.how: automation-def changed by define-automation; the enable hold needs approvals.

invariants.statement: Enabling an automation with a webhook step is held for admin:settings for any principal (R-AUTOMATION-EXTERNAL).

strata.how: perform-outbound-http and webhook steps exist as automation steps; the hold on enabling them needs approvals.

invariants.statement: A content status change is auto only through content.transition; no other path may change status or published_revision (R-CONTENT-STATUS, managed field).

strata.how: status and published revision written only by an operation step; no direct record write path.

invariants.statement: Any change to a Role node is held for approval with approver admin:roles (R-ROLE), including deletion, for humans and agents alike, except the system surface.

strata.how: role membership changes are immediate; held approval not built.

invariants.statement: An agent editing or deleting a system Page is held for admin:settings (R-PAGE-SYSTEM); a human admin edits a system page in place without a hold (CONTRACT §12.11).

strata.how: system pages as ui-screen definitions; the agent hold needs approvals.

invariants.statement: Any change to the Program node is held for admin:settings (R-PROGRAM), for humans and agents, except the system surface.

strata.how: tenant settings written by write-setting; the Program hold is not built, and the site.* path bypasses it (see M18).

invariants.statement: A person writes only their own Preference node; the write is auto (R-PREFERENCE).

strata.how: setting at person level, which takes the invoker's own value (write-setting level person).

invariants.statement: A site.* action (clear, restore, page.put, widget.add, widget.remove, appearance.set) changes Page, Widget or Program nodes without the per-node rules, under its admin:settings check; managed is set only by action handlers.

strata.how: Strata node-level holds do not exist, so an admin operation writing Program appearance is not held; the port must decide whether appearance changes need R-PROGRAM.
strata.note: An agent with admin:settings can run site.appearance.set as direct; see M18.

invariants.statement: An agent deleting a node it did not create is held (R-DELETE-OTHER); deleting its own creation is auto (R-DELETE-SESSION).

strata.how: delete-record steps under object permission; held delete for agents needs approvals.

invariants.statement: A human commit not matched by a Suite row is R-HUMAN-DIRECT and authorised by grants alone; a human's deletion of a system page is R-HUMAN-DIRECT unless checkSuiteDelete refuses it.

strata.how: a tenant operation whose invokers name the roles; a direct object write is refused unless a permission grants it.

invariants.statement: A change that no commit rule classifies is refused (R-NO-MATCH), so the closed table is exhaustive.

strata.how: operation validation refuses an undeclared write path.

invariants.statement: A session id belongs to the principal that first used it; another principal presenting that id is refused UNAUTHENTICATED (this session belongs to another principal).

strata.how: session-record (rec-session) is keyed by session id and bound to one principal; a token resolves to its own session only.

invariants.statement: A revoked session is refused on its next request with UNAUTHENTICATED and reason SESSION_REVOKED, and its realtime socket closes (4401); revoking a person's last role ends their sessions.

strata.how: revoke-session, revoke-other-sessions and end-principal-sessions; RevokeSessions is emitted when a role is lost.

invariants.statement: Plinth member_sessions have no absolute or idle expiry: touchSession only upserts last_seen_at, so a session stays valid until revoked.

strata.how: Strata sessions expire at 12 hours absolute and 2 hours idle, with a sliding idle write; the port should take Strata behaviour, not Plinth behaviour.

invariants.statement: The session id is minted by the client (X-Plinth-Session, pattern ses_ plus 16 to 40 characters) and recorded on first sight; the server does not issue it, so the first presenter owns the id.

strata.how: Strata sessions are issued and looked up server-side (put-session, find-session-by-id, find-session-by-token).

invariants.statement: Development identity shortcuts must not exist in a deployed build: dev-user-<handle> open tokens (only when devOpenTokens is set), the ?as=<handle> principal switch and the avatar-menu switch identity in the shell.

strata.how: development logins are kept beside the tenant (D21) and are not a production sign-in path; the port must build the switch out of production.
strata.note: Verify the switch is compiled out of production builds in the port.

invariants.statement: Sensitive operations require a session authenticated within 15 minutes (step-up). No Suite operation carries a step-up flag; admin.session_revoke, admin.member_create, admin.role_members, site.* and revoke-other-sessions should require it.
source: packages/spec (no stepUp flag on Suite operations, grep)

fundamentals.capability: A grant or role assignment narrowed by a predicate over the target record's fields (for example region = the assignee's region), applied to list queries and to targeted operations, with the scope carried on a role assignment and ANDed into every inherited predicate.
fundamentals.why: Strata's grant union is an allow-only capability or object action with no row predicate; role assignments (role-assignment) carry no scope; policies test a condition on the record but do not narrow a query to the viewer's scope (crates/kernel/src/rules.rs:225-261). The Plinth regional manager (Jonas, EMEA) and every reporting Source with a region column need it.

fundamentals.capability: Attributes of a principal (region, department, tier, title) declared in the product or tenant schema and usable in grant predicates, policy conditions and role scopes.
fundamentals.why: Strata has principal-kind and principal-state but no declared principal attributes for predicates; WG-5500 (principal attributes) is the open gap. Plinth's row predicates read the target member's region, tier and department.

fundamentals.capability: Grants and role assignments with an expiry instant and a status (active, pending_approval, rejected, revoked, expired) so that a grant stops applying on its own.
fundamentals.why: Strata grant and role-assignment types have no expiry or status field (boundary.jsonc grant, role-assignment; docs/design-system.md:1759-1765 says time-bound grants depend on WG-5499). Plinth's grant GrantSpec carries expires_at and status and the authorizer ignores non-live grants (authz-core.ts:166).

fundamentals.capability: A grant with effect deny that overrides allows on the same resource.
fundamentals.why: Strata's grant union carries no effect; a permission is the union of allowed grants (boundary.jsonc grant). Plinth's GrantSpec has effect allow or deny and the authorizer evaluates denies (authz-core.ts:239-260).

fundamentals.capability: Field-level masks on a grant so a role sees a record with some fields removed (for example emails, personal names) without a separate view.
fundamentals.why: Strata's grant union has no column mask (boundary.jsonc grant); Plinth's GrantSpec has column_mask (grant.ts). people:view-private and the rpt_members personal name need it.

fundamentals.capability: A held operation or change: any product operation, node change or agent action can be filed as pending with its frozen input and hash, decided by a second principal who holds the approver permission for that rule, refused for the requester and for the person an agent acts for, and expired after a deadline.
fundamentals.why: Strata has approvals for workflow steps and agent proposals (approvals.rs:1-17, approve-proposal, approve-workflow-step) with separation of duties, but no generic held change or action with a per-rule approver permission, frozen input hash and expiry for node changes and operations.

fundamentals.capability: Exactly one decision on a held item when two approvers decide at once; the second is refused with a conflict.
fundamentals.why: The concurrent approval decision gap is WG-5488. The Plinth decision path reads the hold and checks the approver before committing (change-log.ts:1248-1283); Strata has no held-change decision path to guard.

fundamentals.capability: A person cannot disable their own account, change their own role membership or approve their own request, refused as a named reason (SELF_ACTION).
fundamentals.why: Strata's assign-role refuses above-own grants (require_conferrable) and the last owner but no self-assignment (transition.rs, no self refusal found). Plinth refuses SELF_ACTION on admin.member_status and admin.role_members.

fundamentals.capability: A refusal of any change that would leave a workspace with no administrator, applied to every path including suspension and SCIM.
fundamentals.why: Strata refuses a change that leaves no effective owner (transition.rs:1258-1271) and the SCIM last-owner gap is WG-5486. Plinth states no equivalent for Suite admins (CONTRACT §12.9).

fundamentals.capability: A per-agent permission ceiling (a fixed list) intersected with the delegator's grants, with a deny list that the ceiling can never include, recorded on the agent principal and checked on every call.
fundamentals.why: Strata's delegation token limits scopes to the person's own permissions (tokens.rs:362) but has no fixed agent ceiling list or deny list. Plinth's AGENT_SUITE_CEILING lists admin:settings, which contradicts CONTRACT §3.7.

fundamentals.capability: A per-operation agent policy (direct for reads, preview for dry run then commit with a token, approval for a held commit, deny for FORBIDDEN), applied to every operation an agent can name, with exceptions such as a held refund.
fundamentals.why: Strata has preview-tokens and action-preview but no per-operation agent policy and no approval-filing step for agent calls. Plinth's registry carries agent: direct, preview, approval or deny per action (CONTRACT §3.7, §14.1).

fundamentals.capability: A local account suspended by an administrator (refused on every request, sessions ended) that a tenant administrator can apply and lift, separate from deactivation by the platform.
fundamentals.why: Strata has principal-state active, suspended and erased (boundary.jsonc principal-state) and end-principal-sessions (service only). Tenant-level admin session revocation and local suspension are WG-5490.

fundamentals.capability: An audit entry for every authorization-relevant event: token grants, agent delegations, session revocation, deactivation, role and grant changes, and the audience-scoped events needed for row-level audit reads.
fundamentals.why: Strata's change_audit records role and team changes, invitations and settings but not token grants, agent delegations, session revocation or deactivation (crates/backend/src/change_audit.rs:56-74). WG-5506 is the compliance surface gap.

fundamentals.capability: Revision history of a record with diff between two revisions and an undo that is itself audited and held where required.
fundamentals.why: Strata has audit entries but no product-level revision diff or undo (WG-5503 record history). Plinth's node history and undo come from the kernel change log (GET /history, GET /diff, POST /changes/:seq/undo).

fundamentals.capability: Agent-facing results wrap every free-text string as untrusted data at any depth, driven by the schema (ids, slugs, handles, timestamps not wrapped); a contains_untrusted flag on stored changes.
fundamentals.why: No untrusted marker found in crates/ (grep over crates/*.rs). Plinth wraps action results (engine/src/suite/untrusted.ts) and records contains_untrusted on each change (CONTRACT §14.3).

fundamentals.capability: A metadata source that reads a curated database view (with a region column and no private text) through the same query compiler as a landed source, with as-of reads and the grant, predicate and mask rules applied.
fundamentals.why: Strata's query-def and aggregate-def read tenant object records (boundary.jsonc query-def, aggregate-def); there is no curated-view source. Plinth's twelve rpt_* views and audit.changes need it (CONTRACT §13.1).

fundamentals.capability: Server-decided visibility of a screen, widget, navigation entry or composed page item by the viewer's roles, served as unavailable or pruned, never decided by a client rule.
fundamentals.why: Specified in docs/design-system.md (visibility per role, D-DS-11, line 1759 and 95) but not built (WG-5465). Plinth serves pages with per-item availability and nav filtering (CONTRACT §5A.4).

fundamentals.capability: Reporting queries over large sources with pagination, time-window bounds and a scan limit that does not depend on a fixed row ceiling.
fundamentals.why: The metadata path has a 200 000-row ceiling (CONTRACT §13.1). Strata's aggregate-def has a scan-bound; the scale of curated views beyond the seed is WG-5507.

fundamentals.capability: Chart, table, KPI and board visuals over queries with a data alternative, linked filters and a dashboard as a view of visuals.
fundamentals.why: Charts and boards are WG-5480. Strata has aggregate-def and view-def but no visual or board definition.

fundamentals.capability: Screens and pages composed from placed widgets on a grid, with routes, nav entries, personal copies and a layout editor; the screen is a composition of templates, regions and widgets.
fundamentals.why: docs/design-system.md:42 and :484 specify screens as compositions (D-DS-10) and WG-5464 tracks them; Strata's ui-screen and view-def have one view per route and no grid of widgets.

fundamentals.capability: An app shell with navigation sections and entries served from pages, filtered by the viewer's permission, with counts and an active entry.
fundamentals.why: WG-5468 (app shell and navigation) is not built; Plinth's side nav is generated from pages.list with nav.permission filtering (UI-MAP §5).

fundamentals.capability: A per-widget accessibility contract (roles, labels, keyboard operation, live announcements, a text or table alternative for charts) checked in a gallery before a widget ships.
fundamentals.why: WG-5473 (gallery and accessibility checks) is not built; the accessibility facts in the Plinth widgets are source-level (see the screens' a11y fields) and differ by widget.

fundamentals.capability: A widget runtime contract with versions, so a page written against one contract renders on another without breaking.
fundamentals.why: WG-5478 (rendering contract versions) is not built; Plinth widgets carry a runtime contract (UI-MAP §4.1) that the manifest checks.

fundamentals.capability: Reusable composite interaction patterns (a keyboard-operable grid editor, a list with detail, a form generated from a schema) that a widget can compose.
fundamentals.why: WG-5479 (composite patterns) is not built; Plinth's pages editor and admin list-detail patterns are per-widget.

fundamentals.capability: Named topics that widgets on the same page publish and subscribe to within a link group, with no direct import between widgets.
fundamentals.why: Plinth's page bus (BUS_TOPICS, link_group) has no Strata equivalent; composition (WG-5479 and WG-5464) would host it.
